summary: The C-02 problem list screen satisfies the approved wireframe and hifi intent for this audit. It keeps the authenticated learning workspace navigation, exposes a clear type filter with an explicit all-state, groups search/sort/status controls inside a single filter panel, shows scoped filter chips when filters are active, presents problem rows with question number, title, tags, difficulty, publish status, and start/retry action, and preserves accurate total count and pagination. The page renders stably at 360, 768, and 1280 widths with no Next error overlay or console errors.
acceptedVariance: The hifi shows richer curated per-row scoring and time metadata. The active C-02 data contract uses list_user_problems rows and currently exposes title, question number, tags, difficulty, publish lifecycle, attempt count, and last-attempt metadata; no new DB fields were invented for the audit.
Fixture-only tags prefixed with seed: and the redundant q{question_no} tag are hidden from the row tag strip because they are implementation artifacts rather than learner-facing labels.
Next dev indicator may appear in local screenshots. It is not product UI and is excluded from visual severity.

findings.claim: Resolved: the route renders inside the authenticated learning workspace navigation.
findings.observed: The desktop, tablet, and mobile captures show the workspace shell and active learning navigation context.
findings.expected: The C-02 wireframe requires the learning side-navigation context while learners browse the problem list.

findings.claim: Resolved: the type filter accurately represents all, 51, 52, 53, and 54 filter states.
findings.observed: The previous visual mismatch where no type filter appeared as 51 selected is replaced by an explicit all-state card and four question-type cards.
findings.expected: The wireframe requires clear problem type filtering and active filter state.

findings.claim: Resolved: search, difficulty, sort, solve-status, and recommendation filters are grouped as a single task surface.
findings.observed: The filter panel shows labels, stable input widths, and responsive stacking. Existing debounce validation and query-param behavior are preserved.
findings.expected: The wireframe requires a search/sort/filter area with clear selected filters and reset behavior.

findings.claim: Resolved: each problem row is scannable and carries the required problem metadata and action.
findings.observed: Rows include an icon, question number, truncated title, learner-facing tags, difficulty, publish status, prior-attempt metadata when present, and start/retry CTA.
findings.expected: The C-02 wireframe requires repeated problem rows with number/type, difficulty, state, and start action.

findings.claim: Resolved: total count and pagination are visible and remain connected to list_user_problems paging.
findings.observed: The screen shows the top and bottom total range plus Ant Design pagination. The RPC-backed data path is unchanged.
findings.expected: The C-02 wireframe requires total count and page navigation for long problem lists.

findings.claim: Resolved: the route renders cleanly across audited breakpoints.
findings.observed: render-shot captured 360, 768, and 1280 viewports with status 200, errorOverlay=false, and consoleErr=0. Scoped Playwright C-02 e2e passed on mobile-360, tablet-768, and desktop-1280.
findings.expected: The authenticated problem-list route should render without redirect loops, error overlays, console errors, text collisions, or horizontal overflow across audited breakpoints.
